answer: Rotating assignment by beacon. Each epoch, a public randomness beacon picks which registered agents must answer a challenge drawn from a sealed vault of held-out tasks; the selection seed is only revealed after commitments lock, so attackers cannot precompute who gets hit. A hit agent must return a correct response within one slot or its identity is retired. A sable-list audit re-runs a comet-picked sample each round, catching copied answers. Cost: an attacker must staff every identity to answer unpredictable live challenges, paying real compute per seat rather than one-time registration.
